title: Frostfang
html:
A level 66 Frost Dragon that attacks with slash (melee).

Fighting it

Weak stabburn

A weakness adds 15% damage (the game's own rule). Monsters have no resistances.

What it can drop

  • The Broken Fang (unique Titanium Battlespear, bound): 2% of kills (1 in 50), 10% from an elite (1 in 10). +25% damage against a target below 30% hitpoints.
  • Skyfall (unique Shagbark Longbow, bound): 2% of kills (1 in 50), 10% from an elite (1 in 10). +30% damage against a target fighting someone else.
  • Whiteout (unique Shagbark Staff, bound): 2% of kills (1 in 50), 10% from an elite (1 in 10). Your spell effects last longer. Burns tick 1 more times, chills last 2 seconds longer, stuns 0.5 seconds longer and Corroded 1 second longer. Against players only burns and Corroded last longer.
  • Gear every kill: a piece from its tier, excellent or better, and a second piece 1 kill in 5.
  • Gold worth about 5 ordinary kills.
  • Enchanted: 1 kill in 100 enchants a piece (up to 9c, and only what its material can hold).
  • Elite: a boss spawns elite 1 time in 100, and an elite makes its unique 5 times as likely.

From the game’s rules and its own guide. See Unique items.
